description: Plans de Prévention des Risques Mouvement de Terrain (PPRMT) alèas en Mayenne - 053 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigloire.fr. Area exposed to one or more hazards represented on the hazard map used for the risk analysis of the approved Terrain Movement Risk Prevention Plans (PPRMT) of the Department of Mayenne (assembled on the basis of the CARTORISQUE structure),(lpprmtaleass053). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Risk Prevention Plans Land Movement (PPRMT) alèas in Mayenne - 053" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
